FAUSTO COMMERCIAL PRESENTS
Come for the game. Stay for the city.

A nearly one-acre assemblage for lease on the corridor that connects Little Havana to Downtown Miami, half a mile from Downtown and close to the Miami River District. Strong visibility on SW 1st Street's three-lane, one-way corridor into Downtown, and easy access from SW 6th Avenue.

Built for an established recreation or hospitality operator to open its next open-air destination: a place where customers come for an activity and stay for the experience.

Concept test-fits are illustrative only. Dimensions approximate; subject to survey, zoning and permits.
